results.note: ČTK (12 Nov 18:31) reports Babiš met Zelensky in Dublin on the sidelines of the EPC summit, and Ukrinform (12 Nov) reports Zelensky's meetings with Costa, von der Leyen and Rutte in Dublin.

Ukrinform (12 Nov 08:35 Kyiv) repeats the Air Force morning summary: from 18:00 on 11 Nov Russia launched 123 attack drones (73 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, Banderol/Dan-T, Parodiya) plus ballistic and Zircon missiles, below 180.
ČTK (12 Nov) quotes Babiš speaking to reporters on arrival at the EPC summit in Dublin and reports his bilateral with Zelensky on the summit sidelines that day.

ČT24 (11 Nov, updated 21:17) reports the three leaders only presented the coalition, with the coalition agreement to be ready before the 19 Nov assembly; no signing on 11 or 12 Nov is reported by ČTK or ČT24 (ČT24's Scheinherr topic page has no later item).
ČT24 (11 Nov) reports the coalition will announce the composition of the council next week before the assembly session; only some names circulated via iDNES, not all 11 attributed to the coalition.
ČTK (12 Nov 14:12), citing the Finance Ministry's Cenový věstník issued that day, reports the Friday 13 Nov diesel cap cut by 38 haléřů to 45.49 CZK/l (petrol 40.65).
ONS first quarterly estimate (12 Nov 2026): UK real GDP is estimated to have increased by 0.7% in Q3 (Jul-Sep) 2026, after 0.5% in Q2.
The Tweede Kamer bill page for 37022 records the final vote (Stemmingen 21:05-21:15) as 'Aangenomen (76-74)', and NOS ('Belastingplan aangenomen', 12 Nov 22:50) confirms adoption on 12 Nov.
The bill was adopted on 12 Nov by 76 votes to 74, fewer than the 85 required.

ČTK (12 Nov, 07:04), reporting ČEZ's Q1-Q3 2026 results, gives adjusted net profit (čistý zisk očištěný) of CZK 26.3bn for January-September, up 19% (reported net profit CZK 26.6bn); cez.cz did not render for the reader.

ČTK (12 Nov) reports ČEZ raised its full-year 2026 net-profit outlook to CZK 34-37bn (from 31-35bn; ČEZ's net-profit guidance is the adjusted measure), so the upper bound is above the old range and neither bound is below it; the EBITDA outlook was left at CZK 109-114bn.
Cisco Q1 FY2027 release (PRNewswire via StockTitan, 12 Nov 21:05 UTC) reports revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, above the $18,200 million threshold.
Cisco Q1 FY2027 release (12 Nov 21:05 UTC) guides FY2027 revenue to $74.8-75.8 billion, midpoint $75.3bn, above $72.8bn.
AP story (published 11 Nov 23:06 UTC = 17:06 CT, Wednesday) reports Democrat Scott Colom defeated Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, i.e. the AP call for Colom came on 11 Nov inside the window.

CNN Brasil full text of Lula's Antalya summit speech (11 Nov) praises the three Belém roadmaps, says Brazil will adopt national roadmaps to cut fossil-fuel dependence and asks the Turkish and Australian presidencies to carry the recommendations into the Global Stocktake, but contains no explicit call on countries to adopt or follow a fossil-fuel transition roadmap.

ČTK (11 Nov 18:25) reports Babiš said the government had not discussed sector taxes and he does not expect them to go through the Chamber this week, and minister Havlíček said the cabinet is not now considering sector taxes, i.e. no levy at the 13 Nov second reading.

ČTK (11 Nov 18:25) reports Babiš said the coalition has no agreement on sector taxes and does not expect them in the Chamber this week, while Havlíček said the cabinet is not considering them; no ČTK/ČT24 report of a filed sector-levy amendment to the refinery-tax bill on 11-12 Nov was found.

gCaptain (12 Nov 10:20 PT) and Anadolu (12 Nov 19:11) show the UKMTO/JMIC reports issued on 12 Nov concerned incidents on 10-11 Nov (Dominica Prosperity at 18:00 UTC 11 Nov, NCC Fajr reclassified as an attack), while the two tankers said to have hit mines on 12 Nov rest only on Iranian army claims that Reuters/MarineLink could not verify; no UKMTO/JMIC report of an incident on 12 Nov Gulf time was found.

Fox News live coverage (13 Nov) describes a lull in American strikes on Iran and Benzinga (10 Nov) reports Trump pausing fresh strikes; no White House, Pentagon or CENTCOM confirmation of a US strike on Iranian territory on 12 Nov Tehran time was found.

ČT24/ČTK (11 Nov 10:06, updated 21:17) reports the STAN-SPOLU-Praha sobě coalition was confirmed but council members will be announced next week; Scheinherr only hinted his party would get transport and property, and his transport role is attributed to another portal's report rather than an official nomination.

Kyiv Independent (11 Nov 14:54 UTC) reports only an agreement in Abu Dhabi on a future large-scale exchange with details still to be worked out, and its prisoner-exchange tag page read 14 Nov lists no swap after the 23 Oct 270-person exchange, so no exchange was carried out on 11-12 Nov.

ČTK's reports on Babiš in Dublin (12-13 Nov) cover his meeting with Zelensky on locomotives, trade and support and his SAFE defence-loan interest, but none reports an unambiguous 12 Nov statement that Czechia will not join, pay into or guarantee a new EU loan for Ukraine in 2027.

Euronews (11 Nov 09:58) and other 10-12 Nov coverage report France summoning Iran's ambassador and Iran's written denial, but no outlet reports Iran summoning France's ambassador or head of mission on 11-12 Nov; the earlier resolution of fr-iran-summon-12 found the same.

Euronews (11 Nov 09:58) and Sud Radio/AFP (10 Nov) attribute France's push for EU sanctions to Barrot's statements of Monday-Tuesday 9-10 Nov, before the window; no new statement by a minister, Macron or the Quai d'Orsay on 11-12 Nov was found.

Coverage of the fridge-cyberattack row on 10-12 Nov (Euronews, AFP via Sud Radio, i24) quotes Barrot and the Iranian foreign ministry, but no outlet reports Macron himself referring to the cyberattacks or IRGC responsibility on 11-12 Nov, including at the Dublin EPC summit.
